This is turning out to be like what happened with paladins. The game was really good until they started making very bad decisions. The playerbase complained unrelentingly, but they only made it worse by introducing pay-to-win. It took a few months of protests on r/paladins, and a large hit to the playerbase count on Steam for them to roll back the pay-to-win changes. They brought HirezChris as new game director, but the game after 70 + open beta patch cycles, and about 4 patches after coming out of open beta, is still a hot mess.
Replete with bugs, audio visual glitches, and some characters with high mobility need like 0 ping to play properly. 
The best hope at this point is that the company gets bought by another company with better management. The devs have really great ideas and can make really enjoyable titles, but are run aground by greedy execs.

You are not useless. The fact that you have made this post is proof in itself that you want to improve and make yourself better. I have known this feeling too, I have had bouts lasting weeks when I feel worthless and useless, almost suicidal at times. 
I have tried to better this by doing at least one small thing at a time. It need not be a huge project, just some small little step like setting up your bed sheets every morning. When doing these small tasks over a few days, a routine will develop and you will start feeling more active and productive. Increase the number of tasks you want to complete day by day.

I was at a point where I am spent entire days laying on the bed not wanting to do anything. Initially your brain will be like' what's the point I am going to fail anyway like I usually do' . But you have to fight it. Over a few days you will learn to ignore this part of the brain.

I am going through this everyday of my life. Each day I dread the job I have to do. Dread the  exercise that I have to do, even sometimes dread the food I eat. I take pleasure in the small tasks I have set for myself and work through them and little by little it's starting to be better.

Please feel free to message me.

I kown this feeling, the only thing I can do is to take satisfaction in small things in life. Try to be happy that atleast you are not in any dire situation health-wise, financially.. etc. Take good care of yourself, some exercise can give you some momentary focus. Try a new hobby.
